plain_text:
There is significant variation in the growth and level of climate action across transport-related climate policy
instruments (Figure 3.6 ). Subsidies for electric vehicles (EVs) have driven the largest increase in the sale
of EVs which have become increasingly cost-competitive to internal combustion engine (ICE) cars. Many
countries have expanded subsidies to accelerate EV adoption, contributing to global EV sales reaching an
all-time high in 2024. Nonetheless, EVs represented only 22 % of global passenger car sales in that year
(Figure A.3 ).
